query:
SELECT 
  org.id as org_id,
  org.name,
  COALESCE(acb.credits_remaining, 0) as credits_remaining,
  COALESCE(acb.credits_used, 0) as credits_used,
  COALESCE(sub.status, 'none') as subscription_status,
  COALESCE(sub.plan_id, 'none') as plan_id,
  COALESCE(sub.trial_ends_at, 'none') as trial_ends_at,
  COALESCE(sub.stripe_subscription_id, 'none') as stripe_subscription_id
FROM organizations org
LEFT JOIN ai_credit_balance acb ON org.id = acb.organization_id
LEFT JOIN organization_subscriptions sub ON org.id = sub.organization_id
WHERE org.id = 120001
LIMIT 1;
